DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 相談の予約案内をご覧ですね。今回のご用件は一つでしょうか、いくつかありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are looking at the consultation booking information. Do you have one matter to discuss this time, or several?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引越しについて、住居のことと子どもの通園を相談したいです。引越しの相談として一つ予約すれば両方聞けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 引越しに伴う住居と通園を一つの予約で聞けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: About my move, I want to discuss housing and my child's nursery attendance. If I make one moving consultation booking, can I ask about both?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether one appointment can cover housing and nursery attendance related to moving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用案内には、それぞれ別の担当窓口が書かれています。一つの枠で両方扱えるとは、ここではお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This practice information lists a separate counter for each. We cannot promise here that both can be handled in one appointment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 担当が別なのですね。同じ日に来たいのですが、二つの予約を続けて取れるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 担当が別と確認し同日に二予約を続けられるか知りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: So different people handle them. I would like to come on the same day, and want to ask whether two consecutive appointments are possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm the different departments and say you want to know whether two consecutive appointments on one day are possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 候補の日時と、二つの相談の内容を担当へ伝えましょう。どちらの回答を先に知る必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us tell the staff your possible dates and times and both matters. Which answer do you need first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 住む場所の見込みを先に相談したいです。その住所によって通園の相談内容も変わるかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 住居を先にし予定住所で通園の話が変わる可能性を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to discuss where I may live first. The nursery consultation may also change depending on that address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that housing comes first and the planned address may change the nursery discussion. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その順序の希望も伝えられます。二つを続ける場合でも、移動や相談時間に余裕が必要か確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can communicate that preferred order too. Even if consecutive, let us check whether time is needed for moving between counters and the consultations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 間にどのくらい余裕を置くかも聞きます。同じ日にそろわなければ、住居の相談を先の日にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 移動相談の間の余裕も聞き同日が無理なら住居を先の日にすると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will also ask how much time to allow between them. If both cannot be on the same day, I would like the housing consultation on an earlier day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will ask about time between travel and consultations, and if one day is impossible will arrange housing earlier. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別の日に分ける案もありますね。予約の返事は担当ごとに確認し、一方が決まっただけで両方完了とはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Separate days are another option. Check each department's booking response; do not assume both are complete when only one has been confirmed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 住居を先にして、二つの担当へそれぞれ希望日を伝えます。両方の返事と間の余裕を確かめて予定を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住居を先に各担当へ日を伝え両方の返答と余裕がそろってから予定を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put housing first and give each department my preferred dates. I will decide my schedule after checking both replies and the time in between.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will give dates to each department with housing first, and decide only after both replies and sufficient time are confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、二つの用件を分けたメモを担当へお持ちください。相談の予約がそろいましたら、案内に沿ってお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take a note separating the two matters to the staff. Once both consultation appointments are arranged, come following the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ち帰りの書類を確認しましょう。受付へ渡した物で、まだ気になる物はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Let us check the documents you will take home. Is there anything you handed to reception that you are still concerned about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約案内の原本を最初に渡しました。会計後の束には見当たらないので、預けたままか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 初めに渡した予約案内が会計後の束になく預かり中か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I handed over the original appointment information at the start. It is not in the bundle after payment, so I want to check whether it is still being held.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the appointment information handed in first is still held because it is missing from the bundle after payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 持参された原本について担当に尋ねます。返却する扱いかどうかは、ここで決めずに確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will ask the person responsible about the original you brought. Rather than decide here whether it should be returned, let us check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受付で返してもらう物だと勝手に思っていました。今ある紙が写しなのかも、見ただけではわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 返ると思い込んでおり現在の紙が写しかも判別できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I assumed reception would return it. I also cannot tell just by looking whether the paper I have now is a copy.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you assumed it would be returned and cannot tell whether the current paper is a copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この練習場面では、原本と写しを担当者に照合してもらいます。持参した紙の特徴は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: In this practice situation, the person responsible will compare the original and the copy. Do you remember any features of the paper you brought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 右上に自分で青い丸を付けました。今の束にはその印がないので、別の紙だと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 右上の自筆青丸が今の束にないため別紙と思うと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I put a blue circle in the top right myself. That mark is not in the current bundle, so I think it is a different paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point out that your blue circle at the top right is missing from the current bundle, so you think it is another paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その印を説明しましょう。ご自身のかばんの別の所にしまっていないかは確認しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us explain that mark. Have you checked whether you put it elsewhere in your bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: かばんの書類入れは見ましたが、内側のポケットはまだです。そこも見てから、預けた順番を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 書類入れは見たが内ポケットは未確認なので見てから預けた順を伝えると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I checked the document compartment but not the inner pocket yet. I will check there too, then explain the order I handed things over.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you checked the document compartment but not the inner pocket, and will check it before explaining the handover order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付へ渡した順と、今受け取っている紙を分けて話せると確認しやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Distinguishing the order you handed papers to reception from the papers you now have will make checking easier.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 内ポケットも確認し、青い丸のある原本を最初に渡したと説明します。今の紙を原本と決めず、返却の扱いを聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 内ポケットを調べ青丸原本を最初に渡したと説明し現在紙と返却扱いを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check the inner pocket and explain that I handed over the blue-circle original first. I will not assume the current paper is the original, and will ask about return arrangements.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the inner pocket, explain you handed in the blue-circle original first, and check the current paper and return arrangements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、持参書類の担当に確認します。お帰り前に書類が整理できるよう、返事が出ましたらまたお呼びします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check with the person handling the documents you brought. We will call you again when we have an answer so your papers can be sorted before you leave.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: なくしたかばんの写真をお持ちですね。いまのかばんと同じ状態の写真でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a photograph of your lost bag. Does it show the bag as it is now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 形と本体の色は同じですが、持ち手は後で替えました。写真の黒い持ち手ではなく、今は茶色です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本体は同じだが黒かった持ち手を茶色へ替えたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: The shape and body colour are the same, but I replaced the handles later. They are now brown, rather than the black ones in the photo.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the body is unchanged but you replaced the black handles with brown ones. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 変更した部分を分けて伺います。本体の色は、どのように説明できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us note the changed part separately. How would you describe the body colour?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 灰色の布地です。写真では光で白っぽいですが、実物は灰色で、正面に小さい赤いタグがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 写真では白っぽいが灰色布地と正面赤タグが特徴と述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is grey fabric. The light makes it look whitish in the photo, but the actual bag is grey and has a small red tag on the front.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say it looks whitish in the photo, but grey fabric and a red front tag are its features. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 色とタグを記録します。以前の説明では持ち手を黒と伝えたとのことですが、今回訂正したいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will record the colour and tag. You said the handles were black in the earlier description, and want to correct that now, yes?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、写真だけを見て黒と言ってしまいました。茶色に訂正し、赤いタグが変わっていないことも加えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 黒と伝えた持ち手を茶へ直しタグが不変と加えたいと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, I said black just from looking at the photo. I want to correct it to brown and add that the red tag is unchanged.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to correct the handles from black to brown and add that the tag has not changed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ訂正の相談をつなぎます。前の相談を確認するための控えはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will connect you with the person responsible to discuss the correction. Do you have a record that lets us identify the earlier consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 練習用の相談控えを持っています。番号と日付を示して、同じかばんの情報を直したいと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 控えの番号日付で同じかばんの情報修正と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the practice consultation record. I will show its number and date and explain I want to correct information about the same bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Use the record's number and date to explain that you are correcting information about the same bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別の紛失物として伝えるのではなく、前の説明の修正として整理しましょう。写真は古いことも明記できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us organize this as a correction of the earlier description, rather than a different lost item. We can also state that the photograph is old.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 控えを見せ、持ち手だけ変わった古い写真だと説明します。本体の灰色と赤いタグは現在も同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控えと写真を示し持ち手変更後も灰色本体と赤タグは同じと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show the record and explain it is an old photo and only the handles have changed. The grey body and red tag are still the same.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the record and photo, explaining that after the handle change the grey body and red tag remain the same. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、相談控えと写真を担当へお見せください。訂正箇所を確かめながら、続きの案内をいたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show the record and photo to the person responsible. We will continue guiding you while checking the corrections.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 不在票の文字がにじんでいますね。どの部分が読めずお困りでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: The missed-delivery slip's writing is smudged. Which parts can you not read?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 雨に濡れて、連絡先と荷物の番号が読めません。似た数字で電話をかける前に確認したくて来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 濡れて連絡先と番号が読めず推測で電話する前に確認したいと示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It got wet in the rain and I cannot read the contact details or parcel number. I came to check before calling a guessed similar number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say rain made the contact and parcel number unreadable and you want to check before calling based on guesses. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 読めない数字を推測して連絡しないようにしましょう。宛名と配達の日付は確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us avoid guessing unreadable digits to make contact. Can you confirm the addressee and delivery date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 宛名は私で、日付は昨日です。番号の最後の桁だけは読めますが、それだけで特定できるかはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人宛てと昨日の日付と末尾桁だけ読めるが特定できるか不明と言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is addressed to me and dated yesterday. I can read only the final digit of the number, but do not know whether that is enough to identify it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you can read your name, yesterday's date and only the final digit, but do not know whether identification is possible. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その情報を担当に伝え、照合の方法を確認します。別の案内や、差出人からのお知らせはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will tell the staff that information and check how to match it. Is there any other information or message from the sender?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 差出人から発送したというメールはあります。ただ、そこにも荷物の番号は載っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発送メールはあるが荷物番号はないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have an email from the sender saying it was dispatched. However, that does not show the parcel number either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have a dispatch email but it does not give the parcel number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: メールでわかる情報も、票の情報とは分けて伺いましょう。ここで荷物を特定できたとはまだ言えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us distinguish the email information from the slip information. We still cannot say the parcel has been identified here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 発送の連絡は見せます。再配達の操作を始める前に、正しい番号と問い合わせ先を担当から確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: メールを見せ操作前に正しい番号と窓口を担当へ聞きたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will show the dispatch message. Before starting redelivery operations, I want to confirm the correct number and contact point with the staff.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will show the email and ask staff for the correct number and contact before operating anything. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 正しい連絡先の案内を確認してから進めましょう。濡れた票は、読める部分もあるのでそのまま残してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check the correct contact instructions before proceeding. Keep the wet slip as it is, since some parts remain readable.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 票を残して宛名と日付、発送メールを示します。番号を想像で埋めず、確認後に受取りの方法を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 票を残し宛名日付メールを提示し番号を埋めず確認後に受取りを相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will keep the slip and show the addressee, date and dispatch email. I will not fill in the number from imagination, and will discuss collection methods after confirmation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the slip, show the name, date and email, and discuss receipt after checking without inventing digits. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、読める情報を担当へ引き継ぎます。照合の返事を待って、次の手順を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will pass the readable information to the staff. Let us wait for the matching result, then check the next steps together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 財布のカードが見当たらないのですね。こちらのカードだけか、ほかにもあるか伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You cannot find the cards in your wallet. Is it just our card, or are there others too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二枚ありません。一枚はこちらの銀行の物で、もう一枚は買物用ですが、同じ窓口で対応してもらえると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 銀行用と買物用がなく同一窓口で扱えると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Two are missing. One is from this bank and the other is for shopping, but I thought the same counter could handle both.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a bank card and shopping card are missing and you thought one counter could handle both. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: もう一枚の発行元も確認する必要があります。ここで二枚とも対応できるとは言えません。発行元がわかる控えはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We also need to check the other card's issuer. We cannot say we can handle both here. Do you have a record showing the issuers?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家にある練習用の控えを撮って持ってきました。二枚の名前が別々に書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 練習用控えの写真に別々の名前が載ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I brought a photo of the practice record I have at home. It lists separate names for the two cards.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the photo of the practice record shows different names for the cards. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 控えを見て担当を分けましょう。こちらのカードの対応は、先に担当へ相談します。もう一枚は、発行元に合う連絡先を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us look at the record and identify the relevant staff separately. We will first consult the staff about this card. For the other, let us check a contact appropriate to its issuer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 一枚の相談で両方済んだとは考えません。二つの連絡先と、相談した内容を別の行に書いておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 一枚相談で全部済んだとせず連絡先と内容を別行に記すと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not assume discussing one resolves both. I want to write the two contacts and what we discussed on separate lines.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will not assume one consultation completes everything and will note contacts and discussions on separate lines. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 記録を分けると状態を確認しやすいですね。利用停止が完了したかも、それぞれの担当に確認が必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Separate records make the status easier to check. Each responsible person must also confirm whether suspension has been completed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 窓口の名前と返事を別々に記録します。片方だけ返事が来た場合、もう一方も止まったとは判断しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 各窓口の返事を記録し片方の回答で他方も停止と判断しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will record each contact point's name and response separately. If only one replies, I will not assume the other card has also been stopped.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will record each response and not infer the other card is stopped from only one reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その区別で確認しましょう。最後に財布で二枚を見たのは、いつだったかわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let us check with that distinction. Do you know when you last saw both cards in your wallet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 昨夜は二枚ともありました。発行元と昨夜の状況を伝え、二枚それぞれの対応の返事を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 昨夜二枚あったことと発行元を示しカードごとに返答を確かめると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Both were there last night. I will explain the issuers and last night's situation, and check the response for each card separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say both cards were there last night, identify the issuers and check the response for each. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらのカードの担当へ先にご案内します。もう一枚の連絡先も確認して、順にご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will first take you to the staff for our card. Check the other card's contact too and consult them in turn.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 容器のふたについてのご相談ですね。どのような組合せでお使いになろうとしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are asking about container lids. Which combinations did you try to use?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二組買い、家で並べたら片方のふたがゆるいです。似ているので、自分で取り違えたのかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二組の片方がゆるく似たふたを自分で替えた可能性もあると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I bought two sets, and when I laid them out at home one lid was loose. They look similar, so I might have mixed them up myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain one of two sets is loose and you may have swapped the similar lids yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 組合せをまだ決めつけずに見ましょう。容器とふたを二組とも持ってきていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us look without assuming the combinations yet. Have you brought both sets of containers and lids?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 両方あります。片方は深い型で、もう片方は浅い型ですが、ふたの見た目はほとんど同じです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 両方持参し深型と浅型だがふたは似ていると示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have both. One is deep and the other shallow, but the lids look almost identical.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you brought both, one deep and one shallow, with similar lids. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 底やふたの表示があれば、確認の手掛かりになります。担当が見ますので、無理に押して閉めずにお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Markings on the bottoms or lids could provide clues. The staff will check, so please do not force the lids closed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 押して変形させず待ちます。袋の表示もあるので、買った組合せを比べてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 強く押さず待ち袋表示も使い元の組合せを比べてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will wait without pushing and deforming them. I have the bag labels too; could you compare the combinations I bought?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will wait without forcing them and ask to compare the original combinations using the bag labels too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 袋と商品を照合します。購入の記録もあれば、今回の品を確認しやすいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will compare the bags and products. A purchase record would also help identify these items.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: レシートを持っています。今はどちらの組合せが正しいか不明なので、不具合と決める前に表示を見てください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: レシートがあり組合せ不明なので不具合と断定前に確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have the receipt. Since I do not yet know the correct combinations, please check the labels before deciding it is a defect.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you have the receipt but the combinations are uncertain, and ask for checking before calling it a defect. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: まず表示と状態を確認します。交換などの対応については、その後の案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: First we will check the markings and condition. Please wait for guidance about measures such as replacement after that.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの本体とふた、袋、レシートをまとめて示します。合う組合せと商品の状態がわかってから対応を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二本体とふたと袋とレシートを示し正しい組合せと状態の確認後に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will show both bodies and lids, the bags and receipt together. I will discuss what to do once the matching combinations and product condition are known.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show both bodies and lids, bags and receipt, and say you will consult after the combinations and condition are confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当が順に確認します。返事が出ましたらまたお呼びしますので、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: The staff will check them in order. Please wait here; we will call you again when we have an answer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 散歩コースをお選びですね。パンフレットの一周という表示について、確認したいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are choosing a walking route. Do you want to check what the brochure means by one circuit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一周ならすぐ戻れると思いましたが、線が二つあります。どちらも同じ所を回るのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: すぐ戻れると思ったが二線があり同じ範囲を回るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I thought a circuit would bring me back quickly, but there are two lines. Do both go around the same area?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether two lines go around the same area, though you expected to return quickly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この練習用の図では、細い線は花壇の周りで、太い線は公園全体を回る道です。範囲が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this practice map the thin line circles the flower beds, and the thick line circles the whole park. They cover different areas.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 公園全体ではなく花壇の方を歩きたいです。印刷した紙の線が短く見えて、距離も同じだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 花壇だけを選び紙上の線長から距離も同じと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I want to walk around the flower beds, rather than the whole park. The printed line looked short, so I thought the distances were the same too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose just the flower beds and explain that you thought the distances were equal from the printed line lengths. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 図の見た目の長さだけで、歩く距離を決めない方がよいですね。花壇の道で休む場所も見てみましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is better not to judge walking distance solely by line lengths on the map. Let us also look at rest areas on the flower-bed route.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 途中で休める所があれば、その先まで行くか考えたいです。ベンチの印はどの線につながっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 休んだ先へ進むか考えるためベンチ印がどの道か聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: If there is somewhere to rest on the way, I want to consider whether to continue beyond it. Which line connects to the bench symbol?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask which route the bench symbol is on so you can consider continuing after resting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 花壇の北側にある印が、細い線の道から近い休憩場所です。現地でも表示を見て確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The symbol north of the flower beds is a rest area near the thin-line route. Check the signs there in person too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 北側の表示を見ます。そこから公園全体の太い線へ続いていても、そちらへ進まず花壇の道へ戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 北側を見て太線へ続いても花壇の道へ戻りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will check the northern signs. Even if it connects to the thick line around the whole park, I want to return to the flower-bed route instead of going that way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will check the north side and return to the flower-bed route even if it connects to the thick line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 休憩後に選んだ道へ戻る案ですね。分かれる所では、道の名前も表示と照らして確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your plan is to return to the chosen route after resting. At branches, check route names against the signs too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 花壇の道だけを選び、北側で休んだ後もその道へ戻ります。一周という言葉だけで公園全体へ進まないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 花壇だけを歩き休憩後もその道に戻り一周の語だけで全園へ進まないと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will choose only the flower-bed route and return to it after resting on the north side. I will not head around the entire park just because it says one circuit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will walk only the flower-bed route and return after resting, not enter the whole park solely because of the word circuit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、選んだ線と道の表示を見ながらどうぞ。それでは、花壇の散歩をゆっくりお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40224-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please follow the chosen line and route signs. Enjoy a leisurely walk around the flower beds.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 画面にある切符についてお尋ねですか。ご自身で購入されたものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about the ticket shown on the screen? Did you purchase it yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人が写真を送ってくれました。自分の分も買ってくれたと思ったのですが、受取りの方法が分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人の切符写真で自分の分も購入されたと思い受取りが不明だと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend sent me a photo. I thought they had bought mine too, but do not know how to collect it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your friend's ticket photo made you think yours had been bought too, but collection is unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 写真だけで購入済みとは判断できませんね。友人は何と説明していましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: We cannot determine it has been purchased from a photo alone. What did your friend say?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 参考にしてと書いてあります。今読み直したら、私の分を買ったとは書いていませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 参考にしてという文面で自分の購入とは書かれていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It says to use it as a reference. Reading it again, it does not say they bought my ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the message says it is a reference and does not say your ticket was bought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では友人に確認してから、ご自身の購入を考えましょう。行き先と日付は写真と同じ予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then check with your friend before considering your own purchase. Are your destination and date the same as the photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 行き先は同じですが、私は翌日に行きます。写真の切符をそのまま真似して選ばないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 行き先は同じだが翌日なので写真をそのまま真似しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The destination is the same but I am going the following day. I want to avoid choosing by simply copying the photographed ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the destination is the same but your date is the next day, so you will not simply copy the photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 日付の違いと必要な条件を見ましょう。友人への確認は今できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check the date difference and necessary conditions. Can you check with your friend now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今返信が来て、写真は選び方の参考だったと分かりました。自分の便の条件を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 返信で参考写真と分かり自分の便の条件を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: They just replied, and I now understand the photo was a reference for choosing. Please tell me the conditions for my own service.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the reply confirmed it was a reference photo and ask the conditions for your own service. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご希望の日の案内で、便と切符の種類を比べられます。購入前に内容を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can compare services and ticket types using information for your desired date. Let us check the details before purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 友人の写真は参考だけにして、自分の日付と行き先を伝えて選びます。購入済みとは考えずに手続きをします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 写真は参考とし自分の日付と行き先で未購入から進めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will use my friend's photo only as a reference and choose by stating my own date and destination. I will proceed without assuming a ticket is already purchased.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say the photo is only a reference and you will proceed as not yet purchased using your own date and destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 日付を分けて確認できましたね。案内を見てから購入へ進みましょう。翌日のお出かけが楽しいものになりますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have checked the separate dates. Let us look at the information before buying. I hope you enjoy your trip the next day.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知の相談先を確かめたいのですね。以前のメモもお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to confirm whom to ask about the notice. Do you have your earlier notes too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 前に相談したときのメモがありますが、今回の通知は担当名が違います。古い番号に電話してよいか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 古いメモと通知で担当名が違い旧番号を使うか迷うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have notes from my previous consultation, but this notice names a different person responsible. I am unsure whether to call the old number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the old notes and new notice have different staff names and you are unsure about using the old number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今回は通知に書かれた用件を先に見ましょう。以前は何について相談されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us first look at the matter described on this notice. What did you discuss previously?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前は住所の書き方です。今回の通知は提出した用紙を確認したいという内容なので、同じ相談だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前は住所表記で今回は提出用紙確認だが同じと思っていたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Previously it was how to write my address. This notice says they want to check a form I submitted, so I thought it was the same enquiry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the earlier discussion was address wording and this is a submitted-form check, but you thought they were the same. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相談の内容が違えば、担当も変わることがありますね。今回の通知には、連絡する際の番号がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Different matters can have different people responsible. Does this notice give a number for when you contact them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受付番号らしい数字があります。電話番号とは別の数字なので、どちらを伝えるものか教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 受付番号らしい数字と電話番号を区別し伝えるものを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are digits that look like a reception reference number. They differ from the phone number, so please tell me which I should give.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the apparent reference number from the phone number and ask which to provide. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 連絡先と照会に使う情報を分けて確認します。通知に書かれた期限も見ましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will distinguish contact details from information used for enquiries. Did you also check the deadline on the notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日気づいたので、期限までの日数が少ないです。まず新しい担当へ連絡して、何を準備するか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通知に今日気づき期限が近いので担当へ準備を尋ねたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I noticed it only today, so there are few days left before the deadline. I first want to contact the new person responsible and ask what to prepare.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you noticed the notice today and the deadline is near, so you want to ask the staff what to prepare. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通知の担当に用件と期限を伝えましょう。電話で質問する内容をここで整理できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell the person on the notice the matter and deadline. We can organize the questions for your call here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今回の用件と受付番号、期限をメモします。古い相談の番号だけを頼りにせず、通知の担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 用件と番号と期限を記録し旧番号だけに頼らず通知担当に確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will note this matter, reference number and deadline. I will check with the person on the notice rather than rely only on the old consultation number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will note the matter, number and deadline and check with the notice's staff instead of relying only on the old number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では通知の問い合わせ欄を一緒に見ましょう。相談のメモを持ってご連絡ください。また用件の読み方で迷いましたらお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us look together at the enquiry section. Please contact them with your notes. Come again if you need help understanding the matter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初診のご相談ですね。症状の説明で手伝ってほしいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is a first-visit consultation. Is there anything you would like help with when explaining your symptoms?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 肩に違和感がありますが、日本語で口頭説明するのが難しいです。書いてきたメモを見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 肩の違和感を口頭説明しにくいため日本語メモを見てほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: My shoulder feels uncomfortable, but explaining it orally in Japanese is difficult. Could you look at the note I wrote?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask them to read your Japanese note because describing shoulder discomfort aloud is difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: メモを診療担当へ伝えます。書いた言葉の中で、合っているか不安なものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will pass the note to the medical staff. Are there any words you wrote that you are unsure are correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 重いと書きましたが、荷物が重いという意味ではありません。肩がすっきりしない感じを伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 重いは荷物でなく肩がすっきりしない感じを表したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wrote heavy, but I do not mean a heavy load. I want to convey a feeling that my shoulder does not feel right.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that heavy refers to your shoulder not feeling right, rather than luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その感じ方も一緒に伝えましょう。違和感の場所を、ご自身で示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us convey that feeling too. Can you point out the location of the discomfort yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この肩の後ろ側です。うまく名前を言えないので、診療のときにも手で場所を示したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 肩の後ろを手で示し診療でもそう伝えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is behind this shoulder. I cannot name it well, so I would like to point to it with my hand during the examination too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Point behind your shoulder and say you want to explain that way during the examination too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 言葉だけでなく示して伝えられます。いつからかはメモに書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can communicate by pointing as well as words. Does the note say when it began?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二日前からと書きました。朝と夜で感じが違うことは書いていないので、追記したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二日前からと書き朝夜の違いも追記したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I wrote that it started two days ago. I did not write that it feels different in the morning and at night, so I want to add that.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you wrote two days ago and want to add the difference between morning and night. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 覚えている違いを追記してください。必要な受付書類も一つずつ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Add the differences you remember. Let us also check the required reception documents one by one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メモに朝と夜の違いを足し、場所は診療で示します。書類を渡すとき、症状メモもあるとお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 時間帯の差を追記し場所を示し受付に症状メモがあると伝える方針を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will add the morning and night differences and point out the location during the examination. When handing over documents, I will say I also have a symptom note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will add time-of-day differences, point to the location and tell reception you have a symptom note. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ではメモと書類を順に拝見します。担当へ引き継いだ後、待つ場所をご案内しますね。またお呼びするまでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40225-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let us look at the note and documents in order. After passing them to the medical staff, we will show you where to wait. Please wait until called again.
